name: compare-table
description: Comparison-guide table for the resource-center articles (Asset Panda vs X): a criterion column with small icons, the Asset Panda column under an indigo header with the wordmark, the competitor column under a grey header with its mark (more competitor columns optional), and a Winner column of pills (Asset Panda amber, Tie indigo, the competitor grey), with an optional footnote. Figma: Website Design 2026 > Blog > Compare article (7219:87997).

after_title.description: Accessible name of the Asset Panda column (the header shows the wordmark).

before_title.description: Competitor column heading text, e.g. EAM. Shown after before_mark.

before_mark.description: Short word drawn as the competitor's black rounded mark, e.g. ezo. Leave empty when before_logo is set.

before_logo.description: Competitor logo image URL, used instead of before_mark.

before_logo_alt.description: Alt text of the competitor logo.

extra_columns.description: More competitor columns after the first one, in order. Each: title (heading text), mark (short word drawn as a black rounded mark), logo (image URL, used instead of mark) and logo_alt. Their cells are each row extra[]. Styled like the first competitor column; the table divides its width between all value columns.

winner_column.description: Show the Winner column (when a row names a winner). Off leaves it out and keeps the rows winners for later.

rows.description: Rows. Each: label (required), after and before (the Asset Panda and first competitor cells), winner (pill text: a name containing Asset Panda is amber, Tie is indigo, anything else grey); optional icon_svg (16px criterion icon), after_check (default true) and before_check (default false) for a green check instead of the grey dot, winner_note (small line under the pill, e.g. (CMMS-first)), and extra: one { text, check } per extra_columns column, in order (missing cells show empty). When no row has a winner or winner_note, the Winner column is left out.

note.description: Footnote under the table, e.g. the meaning of an asterisk.
